main_text.l: alexyteria sint, siue quælibet alia, quæ suis
est. Huiusmodi autem vulgata sunt hæc,
satis declarat. Horum numero etiam ascri-
bi debet illa theriacalis aqua,quę illo tem-
dico,cui Stapedius nomen erat, auro char-
rior uenalis prostabat. Quamuis enim eam
quā sufflones fumivori aquam vitę, & vini
spiritum uocant, & in qua dissoluitur ipsa
reddit obnoxium. Adde quòd si morbo ipso
iam correptis propinetur multa, peste ma-
efficiet : propterea quòd tum spiritus, tum

page.notes: Catchword "humores" at lower right, kept out of the text. Page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". Doubtful readings: "cōsentaneum" (long s makes it look like "cofentaneum"), "quatam" (probably quædam), and "charior" (line break "cha-/rior" with "rior uenalis" printed without a space). The printed "dit:propterea" and "efficiet :" are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout.
